claims.text: The recorded run scored 32 test donors.
Intervals use 1,000 donor-bootstrap replicates.
Arm A has 19,018 scorable natural-stratum test cells.
Arm A logistic regression (M4) closed-set macro-F1 was 0.694.
Lower bound of the paired M3 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is below zero.
Upper bound of the paired M3 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is above zero.
Lower bound of the paired M5 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is below zero.
Upper bound of the paired M5 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is above zero.
Lower bound of the paired M6 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is below zero.
Upper bound of the paired M6 minus M4 closed-set macro-F1 interval is above zero.
At OP-cov, Arm A M4 accepted 0.817 of scorable test cells.
At OP-cov, Arm A M4 accepted error was 0.087.
Arm B M4 accepted 0.659 of removed-type (ASC, MAIT, pDC) cells with a known label at OP-cov.
Arm B M3 accepted 0.892 of removed-type cells with a known label at OP-cov.
Arm A M4 natural-unknown false acceptance (20 erythroid cells) was 0.15.
The lower bound of the bootstrap interval for M15 (0.105) lies above the point estimate.
Protein check, 10k file: M4 agreement_accepted was 0.904.
Protein check, 10k file: the denominator of M4 agreement_accepted was 6,009 accepted, protein-resolved cells.
Protein check, 10k file: M4 agreement on gateable predictions was 0.978.
Both replacement CITE-seq files were eligible for the protein check.
The HIHA authors report that their expert annotation was guided by CellTypist Immune_All models and Seurat label transfer.
Models trained on the scTab corpus showed lower macro-F1 on studies added in a later Census release.
Rejection options can fail when a whole population is missing from the reference.
scTab used donor holdout as a compromise between random and study-level splits.
No closed-set macro-F1 difference between M4 and M3, M5 or M6 was resolved at the precision of these intervals; this is not evidence of equivalence.
claims.limitations: Within-study donor-bootstrap intervals over four fixed test studies, conditional on fixed validation thresholds and one training seed; no equivalence margin was pre-specified.

claims.text: Thresholds tuned for 90% validation coverage did not flag most cells of removed near-neighbour types as unfamiliar.
claims.limitations: Three near-neighbour immune classes, mostly rare top-up cells; says nothing about distant or genuinely novel types.

claims.text: Bootstrap intervals for metrics on classes absent from some replicates are uninformative; for the 20 erythroid natural unknowns only counts are reported.
claims.limitations: Replicates without the class yield undefined values; the interval can exclude the point estimate.

claims.text: The two protein agreement measures have different denominators; the gateable-prediction denominator is a smaller method-specific subset that is not recorded, so neither measure is an accuracy and no method ranking is drawn.
claims.limitations: Replacement author-filtered inputs, unknown donor identity, zero-filled genes, fine-versus-coarse label mismatch; descriptive only.
